editorial:
Five couples are all expecting babies at the same time, and their lives get turned upside down in funny and touching ways. You follow a famous fitness guru and her dance partner who are not ready for parenthood, a baby-obsessed author whose husband feels pressure from his dad who is having twins with a much younger wife, a photographer whose husband is unsure about adoption, and two rival food truck owners who end up pregnant after a one-night stand. The movie jumps between these stories with a light, breezy tone that keeps things moving. It feels like a big ensemble comedy where everyone is dealing with the same big life change in different ways.

The cast is packed with familiar faces, and the humor lands more often than not, especially in the scenes with the dads' support group. Some storylines feel rushed and a few jokes fall flat, but the heart is in the right place. If you enjoy feel-good ensemble comedies about family and relationships, this is a fun pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, all five couples welcome their babies in different ways. The celebrities have their baby, the author and her husband bond over their new arrival, the older dad and his young wife deliver twins, the photographer and her husband adopt a baby from Ethiopia, and the food truck rivals become parents together. The movie ends on a hopeful note showing that parenthood comes in many forms and that love and support matter most. Everyone gathers to celebrate their new families.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ensemble comedies about family and relationships.
